def transform(grid):
    """Extend every 2/8 marker upward in its column with a 1-stem.

    A 2 has a four-cell stem including its colored top; an 8 has a
    three-cell stem including its colored top. The original marker row is
    preserved.
    """
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if not grid:
        return out
    base = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                 if any(v in (2, 8) for v in row)), None)
    if base is None:
        return out
    for c, value in enumerate(grid[base]):
        if value in (2, 8):
            height = 4 if value == 2 else 3
            top = max(0, base - height)
            for r in range(top, base):
                out[r][c] = 1
            out[top][c] = value
    return out
PY
